name: lv_obj_tree_walk

ownership.argument: Root, callback and user_data are borrowed synchronously; a null root selects all registered screens on all displays.
ownership.return_value: Integer walk result; callback 0 continues, 1 skips children, 2 ends the current rooted traversal. Null-root dispatcher does not propagate early termination across all screens and returns 2 after its display loop.
ownership.callback_argument: Live object and user_data borrowed only for the synchronous invocation; do not mutate the walked tree or retain unchecked pointers.
